1.name: Bulbasaur
1.description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this pokémon.

2.name: Ivysaur
2.description: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
2.evo_desc: Evolves from **Bulbasaur** starting from Level **16** and Evolves to **Venusaur** starting from Level **32**.

3.name: Venusaur
3.description: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

gmax.description: In its Gigantamax form, Venusaur's flower has grown so large it covers its body. The petals scatter pollen like a volcanic eruption.

4.name: Charmander
4.description: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

5.name: Charmeleon
5.description: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
5.evo_desc: Evolves from **Charmander** starting from Level **16** and Evolves to **Charizard** starting from Level **36**.

6.name: Charizard
6.description: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.

gmax.description: The flame inside its body burns hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit. When Charizard roars, the fire on its wings burns brighter.

7.name: Squirtle
7.description: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

8.name: Wartortle
8.description: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
8.evo_desc: Evolves from **Squirtle** starting from Level **16** and Evolves to **Blastoise** starting from Level **36**.

9.name: Blastoise
9.description: A brutal pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.

gmax.description: Water fired from this Pokémon's central cannon has enough power to blast a hole through a mountain.

10.name: Caterpie
10.description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

11.name: Metapod
11.description: This pokémon is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.
11.evo_desc: Evolves from **Caterpie** starting from Level **7** and Evolves to **Butterfree** starting from Level **10**.

12.name: Butterfree
12.description: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

gmax.description: Its wings have grown to humongous proportions. The scales that shed from its wings can cause paralysis or poisoning.

13.name: Weedle
13.description: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.

14.name: Kakuna
14.description: Almost incapable of moving, this pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.
14.evo_desc: Evolves from **Weedle** starting from Level **7** and Evolves to **Beedrill** starting from Level **10**.

15.name: Beedrill
15.description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

16.name: Pidgey
16.description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

17.name: Pidgeotto
17.description: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.
17.evo_desc: Evolves from **Pidgey** starting from Level **18** and Evolves to **Pidgeot** starting from Level **36**.

18.name: Pidgeot
18.description: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

19.name: Rattata
19.description: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

20.name: Raticate
20.description: It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

21.name: Spearow
21.description: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.

22.name: Fearow
22.description: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

23.name: Ekans
23.description: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

24.name: Arbok
24.description: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

25.name: Pikachu
25.description: When several of these pokémon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
25.evo_desc: Evolves from **Pichu** with **High Friendship** and Evolves to **Raichu** using a **Thunder Stone**.

gmax.description: Its Gigantamax power is so great that it can produce enough electricity to rival a lightning plant.

26.name: Raichu
26.description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

27.name: Sandshrew
27.description: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

28.name: Sandslash
28.description: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

29.name: Nidoranf
29.description: Although small, its venomous barbs render this pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

30.name: Nidorina
30.description: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
30.evo_desc: Evolves from **Nidoran-f** starting from Level **16** and Evolves to **Nidoqueen** using a **Moon Stone**.

31.name: Nidoqueen
31.description: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

32.name: Nidoranm
32.description: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

33.name: Nidorino
33.description: An aggressive pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
33.evo_desc: Evolves from **Nidoran-m** starting from Level **16** and Evolves to **Nidoking** using a **Moon Stone**.

34.name: Nidoking
34.description: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.

35.name: Clefairy
35.description: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
35.evo_desc: Evolves from **Cleffa** with **High Friendship** and Evolves to **Clefable** using a **Moon Stone**.

36.name: Clefable
36.description: A timid fairy pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

37.name: Vulpix
37.description: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

38.name: Ninetales
38.description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.

39.name: Jigglypuff
39.description: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
39.evo_desc: Evolves from **Igglybuff** with **High Friendship** and Evolves to **Wigglytuff** using a **Moon Stone**.

40.name: Wigglytuff
40.description: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

41.name: Zubat
41.description: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

42.name: Golbat
42.description: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
42.evo_desc: Evolves from **Zubat** starting from Level **22** and Evolves to **Crobat** with **High Friendship**.

43.name: Oddish
43.description: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

44.name: Gloom
44.description: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
44.evo_desc: Evolves from **Oddish** starting from Level **21** and Evolves to **Vileplume** using a **Leaf Stone**.

45.name: Vileplume
45.description: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

46.name: Paras
46.description: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.

47.name: Parasect
47.description: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

48.name: Venonat
48.description: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

49.name: Venomoth
49.description: The dustlike scales covering its wings are color-coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

50.name: Diglett
50.description: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

51.name: Dugtrio
51.description: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

52.name: Meowth
52.description: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.

gmax.description: The pattern on its coin has changed. Its body has stretched to an astonishing length.

53.name: Persian
53.description: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

54.name: Psyduck
54.description: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily pokémon will use psychokinetic powers.

55.name: Golduck
55.description: Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

56.name: Mankey
56.description: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.

57.name: Primeape
57.description: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
57.evo_desc: Evolves from **Mankey** starting from Level **28** and Evolves to **Annihilape** via **Special Condition**.

58.name: Growlithe
58.description: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

59.name: Arcanine
59.description: A pokémon that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

60.name: Poliwag
60.description: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.

61.name: Poliwhirl
61.description: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
61.evo_desc: Evolves from **Poliwag** starting from Level **25** and Evolves to **Poliwrath** using a **Water Stone**.

62.name: Poliwrath
62.description: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

63.name: Abra
63.description: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

64.name: Kadabra
64.description: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
64.evo_desc: Evolves from **Abra** starting from Level **16** and Evolves to **Alakazam** via **Trade**.

65.name: Alakazam
65.description: Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.

66.name: Machop
66.description: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

67.name: Machoke
67.description: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
67.evo_desc: Evolves from **Machop** starting from Level **28** and Evolves to **Machamp** via **Trade**.

68.name: Machamp
68.description: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.

gmax.description: One of these Pokémon can carry a cruise ship on its back. Its punches are as fast as bomb blasts.

69.name: Bellsprout
69.description: A carnivorous pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

70.name: Weepinbell
70.description: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
70.evo_desc: Evolves from **Bellsprout** starting from Level **21** and Evolves to **Victreebel** using a **Leaf Stone**.

71.name: Victreebel
71.description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

72.name: Tentacool
72.description: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

73.name: Tentacruel
73.description: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

74.name: Geodude
74.description: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

75.name: Graveler
75.description: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
75.evo_desc: Evolves from **Geodude** starting from Level **25** and Evolves to **Golem** via **Trade**.

76.name: Golem
76.description: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

77.name: Ponyta
77.description: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

78.name: Rapidash
78.description: Very competitive, this pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

79.name: Slowpoke
79.description: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

80.name: Slowbro
80.description: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.

81.name: Magnemite
81.description: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.

82.name: Magneton
82.description: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
82.evo_desc: Evolves from **Magnemite** starting from Level **30** and Evolves to **Magnezone** at **Mt Coronet**.

83.name: Farfetchd
83.description: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

84.name: Doduo
84.description: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

85.name: Dodrio
85.description: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

86.name: Seel
86.description: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

87.name: Dewgong
87.description: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

88.name: Grimer
88.description: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

89.name: Muk
89.description: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

90.name: Shellder
90.description: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

91.name: Cloyster
91.description: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

92.name: Gastly
92.description: Almost invisible, this gaseous pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

93.name: Haunter
93.description: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.
93.evo_desc: Evolves from **Gastly** starting from Level **25** and Evolves to **Gengar** via **Trade**.

94.name: Gengar
94.description: Under a full moon, this pokémon likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

gmax.description: Rumor has it that its gigantic mouth leads not into its body, filled with cursed energy, but directly to the afterlife.

95.name: Onix
95.description: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.

96.name: Drowzee
96.description: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

97.name: Hypno
97.description: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.

98.name: Krabby
98.description: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

99.name: Kingler
99.description: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

gmax.description: The energy from Gigantamaxing caused its left pincer to grow to a massive size. Its pincers can crush anything.

100.name: Voltorb
100.description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.

101.name: Electrode
101.description: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

102.name: Exeggcute
102.description: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

103.name: Exeggutor
103.description: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.

104.name: Cubone
104.description: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this pokémon's real face.

105.name: Marowak
105.description: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

106.name: Hitmonlee
106.description: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

107.name: Hitmonchan
107.description: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.

108.name: Lickitung
108.description: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

109.name: Koffing
109.description: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

110.name: Weezing
110.description: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.

111.name: Rhyhorn
111.description: A pokémon with a one-track mind. Once it charges, it won't stop running until it falls asleep.

112.name: Rhydon
112.description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
112.evo_desc: Evolves from **Rhyhorn** starting from Level **42** and Evolves to **Rhyperior** via **Trade** holding **Protector**.

113.name: Chansey
113.description: A rare and elusive pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
113.evo_desc: Evolves from **Happiny** at **Daytime** + holding **Oval Stone** and Evolves to **Blissey** with **High Friendship**.

114.name: Tangela
114.description: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.

115.name: Kangaskhan
115.description: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.

116.name: Horsea
116.description: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

117.name: Seadra
117.description: Capable of swim­ ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
117.evo_desc: Evolves from **Horsea** starting from Level **32** and Evolves to **Kingdra** via **Trade** holding **Dragon Scale**.

118.name: Goldeen
118.description: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.

119.name: Seaking
119.description: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

120.name: Staryu
120.description: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

121.name: Starmie
121.description: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

122.name: Mr-Mime
122.description: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
122.evo_desc: Evolves from **Mime-jr** via **Level Up** and Evolves to **Mr-rime** starting from Level **42**.

123.name: Scyther
123.description: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

124.name: Jynx
124.description: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

125.name: Electabuzz
125.description: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
125.evo_desc: Evolves from **Elekid** starting from Level **30** and Evolves to **Electivire** via **Trade** holding **Electirizer**.

126.name: Magmar
126.description: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
126.evo_desc: Evolves from **Magby** starting from Level **30** and Evolves to **Magmortar** via **Trade** holding **Magmarizer**.

127.name: Pinsir
127.description: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.

128.name: Tauros
128.description: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

129.name: Magikarp
129.description: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

130.name: Gyarados
130.description: Once it begins to rampage, a GYARADOS will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

131.name: Lapras
131.description: A pokémon that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.

gmax.description: Over 5,000 people can ride on its shell at once. It creates a giant ring of ice to protect itself.

132.name: Ditto
132.description: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

133.name: Eevee
133.description: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.
133.evo_desc: Evolves to **Vaporeon** using a **Water Stone**, to **Jolteon** using a **Thunder Stone**, to **Flareon** using a **Fire Stone**, to **Espeon** via **High Friendship (Day)**, to **Umbreon** via **High Friendship (Night)**, to **Leafeon** using a **Leaf Stone**, to **Glaceon** using an **Ice Stone**, or to **Sylveon** via **High Friendship + Fairy Move**.

gmax.description: Gigantamax energy has fluffed up the fur around its neck. The fur is softer and richer than the finest silk.

134.name: Vaporeon
134.description: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

135.name: Jolteon
135.description: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.

136.name: Flareon
136.description: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

137.name: Porygon
137.description: A pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

138.name: Omanyte
138.description: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

139.name: Omastar
139.description: A prehistoric pokémon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.

140.name: Kabuto
140.description: A pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

141.name: Kabutops
141.description: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim­ ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

142.name: Aerodactyl
142.description: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

143.name: Snorlax
143.description: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

gmax.description: Seeds that attached to its belly grew into a huge tree. It barely moves, even when battling.

144.name: Articuno
144.description: A legendary bird pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

145.name: Zapdos
145.description: A legendary bird pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

146.name: Moltres
146.description: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

147.name: Dratini
147.description: Long considered a mythical pokémon until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.

148.name: Dragonair
148.description: A mystical pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.
148.evo_desc: Evolves from **Dratini** starting from Level **30** and Evolves to **Dragonite** starting from Level **55**.

149.name: Dragonite
149.description: An extremely rarely seen marine pokémon. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

150.name: Mewtwo
150.description: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

151.name: Mew
151.description: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

152.name: Chikorita
152.description: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.

153.name: Bayleef
153.description: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.
153.evo_desc: Evolves from **Chikorita** starting from Level 16 and Evolves to **Meganium** starting from Level 32.

154.name: Meganium
154.description: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

155.name: Cyndaquil
155.description: It is timid, and always curls it­ self up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

156.name: Quilava
156.description: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.
156.evo_desc: Evolves from **Cyndaquil** starting from Level 14 and Evolves to **Typhlosion** starting from Level 36.

157.name: Typhlosion
157.description: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

158.name: Totodile
158.description: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

159.name: Croconaw
159.description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
159.evo_desc: Evolves from **Totodile** starting from Level 18 and Evolves to **Feraligatr** starting from Level 30.

160.name: Feraligatr
160.description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

161.name: Sentret
161.description: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

162.name: Furret
162.description: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

163.name: Hoothoot
163.description: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

164.name: Noctowl
164.description: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

165.name: Ledyba
165.description: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.

166.name: Ledian
166.description: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

167.name: Spinarak
167.description: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

168.name: Ariados
168.description: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.

169.name: Crobat
169.description: It flies so si­ lently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

170.name: Chinchou
170.description: It shoots positive and negative elec­ tricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

171.name: Lanturn
171.description: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

172.name: Pichu
172.description: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

173.name: Cleffa
173.description: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

174.name: Igglybuff
174.description: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

175.name: Togepi
175.description: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

176.name: Togetic
176.description: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, car­ ing people and shower them with happiness.

177.name: Natu
177.description: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always star­ ing at something.

178.name: Xatu
178.description: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

179.name: Mareep
179.description: If static elec­ tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

180.name: Flaaffy
180.description: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
180.evo_desc: Evolves from **Mareep** starting from Level 15 and Evolves to **Ampharos** starting from Level 30.

181.name: Ampharos
181.description: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

182.name: Bellossom
182.description: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

183.name: Marill
183.description: The tip of its tail, which con­ tains oil that is lighter than wa­ ter, lets it swim without drowning.

184.name: Azumarill
184.description: By keeping still and listening in­ tently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.

185.name: Sudowoodo
185.description: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composi­ tion appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.

186.name: Politoed
186.description: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather­ ing from far and wide.

187.name: Hoppip
187.description: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.

188.name: Skiploom
188.description: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluc­ tuates up and down.
188.evo_desc: Evolves from **Hoppip** starting from Level 18 and Evolves to **Jumpluff** starting from Level 27.

189.name: Jumpluff
189.description: Once it catches the wind, it deft­ ly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.

190.name: Aipom
190.description: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

191.name: Sunkern
191.description: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.

192.name: Sunflora
192.description: It converts sun­ light into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

193.name: Yanma
193.description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter win­ dows in the area.

194.name: Wooper
194.description: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

195.name: Quagsire
195.description: This carefree Pokémon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

196.name: Espeon
196.description: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its ene­ my's actions.

197.name: Umbreon
197.description: When agitated, this Pokémon pro­ tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

198.name: Murkrow
198.description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

199.name: Slowking
199.description: It has incredible intellect and in­ tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

200.name: Misdreavus
200.description: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

201.name: Unown
201.description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tab­ lets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

202.name: Wobbuffet
202.description: It hates light and shock. If attack­ ed, it inflates its body to pump up its counter­ strike.

203.name: Girafarig
203.description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

204.name: Pineco
204.description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

205.name: Forretress
205.description: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.

206.name: Dunsparce
206.description: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furi­ ously boring into the ground with its tail.

207.name: Gligar
207.description: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the star­ tled victim to inject poison.

208.name: Steelix
208.description: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

209.name: Snubbull
209.description: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.

210.name: Granbull
210.description: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If at­ tacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

211.name: Qwilfish
211.description: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

212.name: Scizor
212.description: It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

213.name: Shuckle
213.description: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

214.name: Heracross
214.description: It is usually docile, but if it is disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

215.name: Sneasel
215.description: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud­ denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

216.name: Teddiursa
216.description: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

217.name: Ursaring
217.description: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.

218.name: Slugma
218.description: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

219.name: Magcargo
219.description: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

220.name: Swinub
220.description: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

221.name: Piloswine
221.description: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

222.name: Corsola
222.description: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.

223.name: Remoraid
223.description: It has superb ac­ curacy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

224.name: Octillery
224.description: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

225.name: Delibird
225.description: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

226.name: Mantine
226.description: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

227.name: Skarmory
227.description: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

228.name: Houndour
228.description: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

229.name: Houndoom
229.description: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

230.name: Kingdra
230.description: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

231.name: Phanpy
231.description: It swings its long snout around play­ fully, but because it is so strong, that can be dan­ gerous.

232.name: Donphan
232.description: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.

233.name: Porygon2
233.description: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

234.name: Stantler
234.description: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where real­ ity is distorted.

235.name: Smeargle
235.description: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

236.name: Tyrogue
236.description: It is always bursting with en­ ergy. To make it­ self stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

237.name: Hitmontop
237.description: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.

238.name: Smoochum
238.description: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

239.name: Elekid
239.description: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

240.name: Magby
240.description: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.

241.name: Miltank
241.description: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

242.name: Blissey
242.description: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY's egg be­ comes unfailingly caring and pleas­ ant to everyone.

243.name: Raikou
243.description: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

244.name: Entei
244.description: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Un­ able to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

245.name: Suicune
245.description: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

246.name: Larvitar
246.description: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

247.name: Pupitar
247.description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.
247.evo_desc: Evolves from **Larvitar** starting from Level 30 and Evolves to **Tyranitar** starting from Level 55.

248.name: Tyranitar
248.description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

249.name: Lugia
249.description: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

250.name: Ho-Oh
250.description: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies con­ tinuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.

251.name: Celebi
251.description: This Pokémon wan­ders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

252.name: Treecko
252.description: Treecko makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously attacks anything approaching its nest.

253.name: Grovyle
253.description: The leaves growing out of Grovyle's body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest.
253.evo_desc: Evolves from Treecko starting from Level 16 and Evolves to **Sceptile** starting from Level **36**.

254.name: Sceptile
254.description: The leaves growing on Sceptile's body are very sharp edged. This Pokémon is very agile.
254.evo_desc: Evolves from Grovyle starting from Level 36
254.mega_description: Thanks to the power of Mega Evolution, its tail can detach and be fired like a missile, regenerating immediately.

255.name: Torchic
255.description: Torchic sticks with its Trainer, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokémon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F.

256.name: Combusken
256.description: Combusken toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. It possesses the drive to kick.
256.evo_desc: Evolves from Torchic starting from Level 16 and Evolves to **Blaziken** starting from Level **36**.

257.name: Blaziken
257.description: In battle, Blaziken blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously.
257.evo_desc: Evolves from Combusken starting from Level 36
257.mega_description: As it unleashes a flurry of kicks, its legs can begin to burn from the friction of the atmosphere.

258.name: Mudkip
258.description: The fin on Mudkip's head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, it can determine what is taking place around it.

259.name: Marshtomp
259.description: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming.
259.evo_desc: Evolves from Mudkip starting from Level 16 and Evolves to **Swampert** starting from Level **36**.

260.name: Swampert
260.description: Swampert is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton.
260.evo_desc: Evolves from Marshtomp starting from Level 36
260.mega_description: The power of Mega Evolution has made it burly. It can anchor its body in the ground to deliver punches that shatter boulders.

261.name: Poochyena
261.description: At first sight, Poochyena takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokémon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted.

262.name: Mightyena
262.description: Mightyena gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body.
262.evo_desc: Evolves from Poochyena starting from Level 18

263.name: Zigzagoon
263.description: Zigzagoon gets interested in everything, which is why it zigs and zags. It is good at finding items in the grass.

264.name: Linoone
264.description: When hunting, Linoone will make a beeline for prey. It is extremely fast and can tackle with immense force.
264.evo_desc: Evolves from Zigzagoon starting from Level 20

265.name: Wurmple
265.description: Wurmple is targeted by Swellow as prey. This Pokémon will try to resist by pointing the spikes on its rear at the attacking predator.

266.name: Silcoon
266.description: Silcoon tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. It stays there to await evolution.
266.evo_desc: Evolves from Wurmple starting from Level 7 and Evolves to **Beautifly** starting from Level **10**.

267.name: Beautifly
267.description: Beautifly has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to suck the prey's fluids.
267.evo_desc: Evolves from Silcoon starting from Level 10

268.name: Cascoon
268.description: Cascoon makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth.
268.evo_desc: Evolves from Wurmple starting from Level 7 and Evolves to **Dustox** starting from Level **10**.

269.name: Dustox
269.description: Dustox is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokémon are attracted by the bright lights of cities.
269.evo_desc: Evolves from Cascoon starting from Level 10

270.name: Lotad
270.description: Lotad live in ponds and lakes. Photosynthesis occurs in the leaf on its head, supplying it with energy.

271.name: Lombre
271.description: Lombre is nocturnal—it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief maker.
271.evo_desc: Evolves from Lotad starting from Level 14 and Evolves to **Ludicolo** using **Water Stone**.

272.name: Ludicolo
272.description: Ludicolo begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This Pokémon is said to appear when it hears the singing of children.
272.evo_desc: Evolves from Lombre using Water Stone

273.name: Seedot
273.description: Seedot attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch.

274.name: Nuzleaf
274.description: Nuzleaf live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people.
274.evo_desc: Evolves from Seedot starting from Level 14 and Evolves to **Shiftry** using **Leaf Stone**.

275.name: Shiftry
275.description: Shiftry is a mysterious Pokémon that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years.
275.evo_desc: Evolves from Nuzleaf using Leaf Stone

276.name: Taillow
276.description: Taillow courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be.

277.name: Swellow
277.description: Swellow flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey.
277.evo_desc: Evolves from Taillow starting from Level 22

278.name: Wingull
278.description: Wingull has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations.

279.name: Pelipper
279.description: Pelipper is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon and eggs inside its massive bill.
279.evo_desc: Evolves from Wingull starting from Level 25

280.name: Ralts
280.description: Ralts senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This Pokémon rarely appears before people.

281.name: Kirlia
281.description: It is said that a Kirlia that is exposed to the positive emotions of its Trainer grows beautiful.
281.evo_desc: Evolves from Ralts starting from Level 20 and Evolves to **Gardevoir** starting from Level **30**.

282.name: Gardevoir
282.description: Gardevoir has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its Trainer, this Pokémon is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
282.evo_desc: Evolves from Kirlia starting from Level 30
282.mega_description: By opening its heart, it can sense the feelings of others. Its psychic power has been amplified by Mega Evolution.

283.name: Surskit
283.description: From the tips of its feet, Surskit secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating.

284.name: Masquerain
284.description: Masquerain intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas.
284.evo_desc: Evolves from Surskit starting from Level 22

285.name: Shroomish
285.description: Shroomish live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves.

286.name: Breloom
286.description: Breloom closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms.
286.evo_desc: Evolves from Shroomish starting from Level 23

287.name: Slakoth
287.description: Slakoth lolls around for over 20 hours every day. It has little interest in moving.

288.name: Vigoroth
288.description: Vigoroth is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can't tolerate sitting still for even a minute.
288.evo_desc: Evolves from Slakoth starting from Level 18 and Evolves to **Slaking** starting from Level **36**.

289.name: Slaking
289.description: Slaking spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass that grows within its reach.
289.evo_desc: Evolves from Vigoroth starting from Level 36

290.name: Nincada
290.description: Nincada lives underground for many years in complete darkness. It absorbs moisture from the roots of trees.

291.name: Ninjask
291.description: Ninjask moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, although its crying can be clearly heard.
291.evo_desc: Evolves from Nincada starting from Level 20

292.name: Shedinja
292.description: Shedinja's hard body doesn't move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell.

293.name: Whismur
293.description: Whismur is very shy. If it starts to cry loudly, it startles itself and cries even harder.

294.name: Loudred
294.description: Loudred's bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes.
294.evo_desc: Evolves from Whismur starting from Level 20 and Evolves to **Exploud** starting from Level **40**.

295.name: Exploud
295.description: Exploud triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. Its voice can be heard from over six miles away.
295.evo_desc: Evolves from Loudred starting from Level 40

296.name: Makuhita
296.description: Makuhita is tenacious. Whatever the situation, it keeps getting back up. It toughens its body by crashing into thick trees.

297.name: Hariyama
297.description: Hariyama has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength.
297.evo_desc: Evolves from Makuhita starting from Level 24

298.name: Azurill
298.description: Azurill spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too.

299.name: Nosepass
299.description: Nosepass's magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these Pokémon meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other.

300.name: Skitty
300.description: Skitty is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this Pokémon lives in holes in the trees of forests.

301.name: Delcatty
301.description: Delcatty prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace.
301.evo_desc: Evolves from Skitty using Moon Stone

302.name: Sableye
302.description: Sableye digs the ground with sharp claws to find rocks that it eats. Substances in the eaten rocks crystallize to form the gems on its body.
302.mega_description: The jewel on its chest has enlarged and detached. It uses the massive gem as a shield against attacks.

303.name: Mawile
303.description: Mawile's huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard.
303.mega_description: It now has two huge jaws on the back of its head. These jaws can gnaw through iron beams.

304.name: Aron
304.description: Aron has a body of steel. With one all-out charge, this Pokémon can demolish even a heavy dump truck.

305.name: Lairon
305.description: Lairon feeds on iron contained in rocks and water. It makes its nest on mountains where iron ore is buried.
305.evo_desc: Evolves from Aron starting from Level 32 and Evolves to **Aggron** starting from Level **42**.

306.name: Aggron
306.description: Aggron claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment.
306.evo_desc: Evolves from Lairon starting from Level 42
306.mega_description: The destructive power of its horns can turn a tank into scrap metal. It is essentially a moving fortress.

307.name: Meditite
307.description: Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day.

308.name: Medicham
308.description: Medicham gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.
308.evo_desc: Evolves from Meditite starting from Level 37
308.mega_description: Through Mega Evolution, its mental power has been sharpened to its utmost limit. It fights using a distinct style of movement.

309.name: Electrike
309.description: Electrike stores electricity in its long body hair. It stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges to run fast.

310.name: Manectric
310.description: Manectric is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires.
310.evo_desc: Evolves from Electrike starting from Level 26
310.mega_description: The lightning it generates is so powerful that it can't be stored in its body, so it discharges constantly.

311.name: Plusle
311.description: Plusle acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokémon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks.

312.name: Minun
312.description: Minun sends electricity into the ground to promote the growth of plants.

313.name: Volbeat
313.description: With the arrival of night, Volbeat emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of the light.

314.name: Illumise
314.description: Illumise attracts a swarm of Volbeat using a sweet fragrance. It guides the Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky.

315.name: Roselia
315.description: Roselia shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms.

316.name: Gulpin
316.description: Gulpin's body is mostly its stomach. It can swallow something the size of itself in one gulp.

317.name: Swalot
317.description: Swalot swallows anything and everything. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.
317.evo_desc: Evolves from Gulpin starting from Level 26

318.name: Carvanha
318.description: Carvanha has jaws that are strong enough to rip through a boat's hull. They form packs to attack ships.

319.name: Sharpedo
319.description: Sharpedo is known as the bully of the sea. Its fangs grow back immediately if they snap off.
319.evo_desc: Evolves from Carvanha starting from Level 30
319.mega_description: The spikes on its body have grown, and it can now swim at speeds exceeding 125 mph.

320.name: Wailmer
320.description: Wailmer's nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful Pokémon loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater.

321.name: Wailord
321.description: Wailord is the largest of all identified Pokémon up to now. This giant Pokémon swims languorously in the vast open sea.
321.evo_desc: Evolves from Wailmer starting from Level 40

322.name: Numel
322.description: Magma of 2,200 degrees F courses through Numel's body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens.

323.name: Camerupt
323.description: Camerupt has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body.
323.evo_desc: Evolves from Numel starting from Level 33
323.mega_description: The magma in its body has reached a boiling point. It constantly erupts, turning the surrounding area into a sea of fire.

324.name: Torkoal
324.description: Torkoal digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it.

325.name: Spoink
325.description: Spoink bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump.

326.name: Grumpig
326.description: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe.
326.evo_desc: Evolves from Spoink starting from Level 32

327.name: Spinda
327.description: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

328.name: Trapinch
328.description: Trapinch is a patient hunter. It digs a pitfall trap in a desert and waits for its prey to fall in.

329.name: Vibrava
329.description: Vibrava generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings.
329.evo_desc: Evolves from Trapinch starting from Level 35 and Evolves to **Flygon** starting from Level **45**.

330.name: Flygon
330.description: Flygon is nicknamed 'the elemental spirit of the desert.' Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand.
330.evo_desc: Evolves from Vibrava starting from Level 45

331.name: Cacnea
331.description: Cacnea lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey.

332.name: Cacturne
332.description: During the daytime, Cacturne remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun.
332.evo_desc: Evolves from Cacnea starting from Level 32

333.name: Swablu
333.description: Swablu has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This Pokémon is not frightened by people.

334.name: Altaria
334.description: Altaria dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds.
334.evo_desc: Evolves from Swablu starting from Level 35
334.mega_description: Its voice has become even more beautiful. It wraps its enemies in its fluffy feathers and sings them a lullaby.

335.name: Zangoose
335.description: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws.

336.name: Seviper
336.description: Seviper's swordlike tail serves two purposes - it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison.

337.name: Lunatone
337.description: Lunatone becomes active around the time of the full moon. Instead of walking, it moves by floating in midair.

338.name: Solrock
338.description: Solrock absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense the thoughts of others.

339.name: Barboach
339.description: Barboach's sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. It hides in mud, leaving only its whiskers exposed.

340.name: Whiscash
340.description: Whiscash is extremely territorial. It thrashes about to trigger a massive earthquake if a foe approaches.
340.evo_desc: Evolves from Barboach starting from Level 30

341.name: Corphish
341.description: Corphish catches prey with its sharp claws. It has no problem living in filthy water.

342.name: Crawdaunt
342.description: Crawdaunt is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
342.evo_desc: Evolves from Corphish starting from Level 30

343.name: Baltoy
343.description: Baltoy moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some have been seen spinning on their heads.

344.name: Claydol
344.description: Claydol is said to be a doll of clay made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray.
344.evo_desc: Evolves from Baltoy starting from Level 36

345.name: Lileep
345.description: Lileep became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. It attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor.

346.name: Cradily
346.description: Cradily roams around the ocean floor in search of food. It freely extends its tree trunk-like neck.
346.evo_desc: Evolves from Lileep starting from Level 40

347.name: Anorith
347.description: Anorith is said to be a type of Pokémon predecessor, with eight wings at the sides of its body.

348.name: Armaldo
348.description: Armaldo is a Pokémon species that became extinct in prehistoric times. It is said to have walked on its hind legs.
348.evo_desc: Evolves from Anorith starting from Level 40

349.name: Feebas
349.description: Feebas is a tough Pokémon that can live in any kind of water, but it is ragged and shabby.

350.name: Milotic
350.description: Milotic is said to be the most beautiful of all the Pokémon. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility.

351.name: Castform
351.description: Castform's appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature.

352.name: Kecleon
352.description: Kecleon is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings.

353.name: Shuppet
353.description: Shuppet grows by feeding on dark emotions, such as vengefulness and envy, in the hearts of people.

354.name: Banette
354.description: Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body.
354.evo_desc: Evolves from Shuppet starting from Level 37
354.mega_description: Mega Evolution has increased its vindictiveness. It cannot help but curse its own Trainer.

355.name: Duskull
355.description: Duskull wanders lost among the deep darkness of midnight. It loves the crying of children.

356.name: Dusclops
356.description: Dusclops's body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole.
356.evo_desc: Evolves from Duskull starting from Level 37 and Evolves to **Dusknoir** using **Trade**.

357.name: Tropius
357.description: Tropius flies by flapping the leaves on its back as if they were wings. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is very sweet.

358.name: Chimecho
358.description: Chimecho makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokémon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves.

359.name: Absol
359.description: Absol has the ability to foretell the coming of natural disasters. It lives in harsh, rugged mountain environments.
359.mega_description: The energy of Mega Evolution makes its fur stand on end, giving it the appearance of having wings.

360.name: Wynaut
360.description: Wynaut loves to eat sweet fruits. It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike arms.

361.name: Snorunt
361.description: Snorunt lives in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this Pokémon steals away to live quietly in deep caverns.

362.name: Glalie
362.description: Glalie has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. It has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
362.evo_desc: Evolves from Snorunt starting from Level 42
362.mega_description: The excess energy from Mega Evolution vents from its mouth, forcing its jaw open permanently.

363.name: Spheal
363.description: Spheal is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this Pokémon eat, they all clap at once.

364.name: Sealeo
364.description: Sealeo has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time.
364.evo_desc: Evolves from Spheal starting from Level 32 and Evolves to **Walrein** starting from Level **44**.

365.name: Walrein
365.description: Walrein swims all over in frigid seawater while crushing icebergs with its grand tusks.
365.evo_desc: Evolves from Sealeo starting from Level 44

366.name: Clamperl
366.description: Clamperl makes a single pearl during its lifetime. Such a pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

367.name: Huntail
367.description: Huntail's tail is shaped like a fish. It uses the tail to attract prey, then swallows the prey whole.

368.name: Gorebyss
368.description: Gorebyss lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure.

369.name: Relicanth
369.description: Relicanth is a rare species that was discovered in deep-sea explorations. It has not changed its form for 100 million years.

370.name: Luvdisc
370.description: Luvdisc lives in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped Pokémon earned its name by swimming after loving couples.

371.name: Bagon
371.description: Bagon harbors a never-ending dream of one day soaring high among the clouds.

372.name: Shelgon
372.description: Inside Shelgon's armor, its cells are in the midst of transformation to create a new body.
372.evo_desc: Evolves from Bagon starting from Level 30 and Evolves to **Salamence** starting from Level **50**.

373.name: Salamence
373.description: Salamence came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings.
373.evo_desc: Evolves from Shelgon starting from Level 50
373.mega_description: The stress of Mega Evolution causes its wings to merge into a single, crescent-shaped unit.

374.name: Beldum
374.description: Beldum keeps itself floating by generating a magnetic force that repels earth's magnetic field.

375.name: Metang
375.description: When two Beldum fuse together, Metang is formed. The brains of the Beldum are joined by a magnetic nervous system.
375.evo_desc: Evolves from Beldum starting from Level 20 and Evolves to **Metagross** starting from Level **45**.

376.name: Metagross
376.description: Metagross has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can puzzle out difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer.
376.evo_desc: Evolves from Metang starting from Level 45
376.mega_description: It is the result of one Metagross, one Metang, and two Beldum linking up. Its intelligence is unparalleled.

377.name: Regirock
377.description: Regirock was sealed away by people long ago. If this Pokémon's body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.

378.name: Regice
378.description: Regice's body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body cannot be melted, even by fire.

379.name: Registeel
379.description: Registeel has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow.

380.name: Latias
380.description: Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly.
380.mega_description: It is capable of flying faster than a jet plane. It tucks in its arms to minimize air resistance.

381.name: Latios
381.description: Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head.
381.mega_description: Its intelligence has surpassed human levels. It can fly faster than a jet and understands human speech.

382.name: Kyogre
382.description: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon.
382.mega_description: Through Primal Reversion, it has regained its true form. It can summon storms to expand the seas.

383.name: Groudon
383.description: Groudon has long been described in mythology as the Pokémon that raised lands and expanded continents.
383.mega_description: Through Primal Reversion, it has reclaimed its original power. It can evaporate water and expand the land.

384.name: Rayquaza
384.description: Rayquaza lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth's ozone layer, never descending to the ground.
384.mega_description: The energy from the meteorites it consumes powers its Mega Evolution. Its body shines with emerald light.

385.name: Jirachi
385.description: A legend states that Jirachi will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens.

386.name: Deoxys
386.description: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys.

387.name: Turtwig
387.description: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

388.name: Grotle
388.description: A GROTLE that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

389.name: Torterra
389.description: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

390.name: Chimchar
390.description: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

391.name: Monferno
391.description: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

392.name: Infernape
392.description: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

393.name: Piplup
393.description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

394.name: Prinplup
394.description: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

395.name: Empoleon
395.description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

396.name: Starly
396.description: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

397.name: Staravia
397.description: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

398.name: Staraptor
398.description: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

399.name: Bidoof
399.description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

400.name: Bibarel
400.description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

401.name: Kricketot
401.description: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

402.name: Kricketune
402.description: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

403.name: Shinx
403.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

404.name: Luxio
404.description: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

405.name: Luxray
405.description: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

406.name: Budew
406.description: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

407.name: Roserade
407.description: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

408.name: Cranidos
408.description: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

409.name: Rampardos
409.description: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

410.name: Shieldon
410.description: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

411.name: Bastiodon
411.description: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

412.name: Burmy
412.description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

sandy.description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

trash.description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

413.name: Wormadam
413.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

sandy.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

trash.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

414.name: Mothim
414.description: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

415.name: Combee
415.description: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.

416.name: Vespiquen
416.description: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

417.name: Pachirisu
417.description: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

418.name: Buizel
418.description: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

419.name: Floatzel
419.description: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

420.name: Cherubi
420.description: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

421.name: Cherrim
421.description: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

sunshine.description: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

422.name: Shellos
422.description: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

east.description: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

423.name: Gastrodon
423.description: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

east.description: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

424.name: Ambipom
424.description: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

425.name: Drifloon
425.description: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

426.name: Drifblim
426.description: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

427.name: Buneary
427.description: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

428.name: Lopunny
428.description: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

429.name: Mismagius
429.description: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

430.name: Honchkrow
430.description: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

431.name: Glameow
431.description: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

432.name: Purugly
432.description: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.

433.name: Chingling
433.description: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

434.name: Stunky
434.description: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

435.name: Skuntank
435.description: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

436.name: Bronzor
436.description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

437.name: Bronzong
437.description: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

438.name: Bonsly
438.description: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.

439.name: Mime-jr
439.description: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

440.name: Happiny
440.description: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

441.name: Chatot
441.description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

442.name: Spiritomb
442.description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

443.name: Gible
443.description: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

444.name: Gabite
444.description: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.

445.name: Garchomp
445.description: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

446.name: Munchlax
446.description: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

447.name: Riolu
447.description: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

448.name: Lucario
448.description: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

449.name: Hippopotas
449.description: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

450.name: Hippowdon
450.description: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

451.name: Skorupi
451.description: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

452.name: Drapion
452.description: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

453.name: Croagunk
453.description: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

454.name: Toxicroak
454.description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

455.name: Carnivine
455.description: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

456.name: Finneon
456.description: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

457.name: Lumineon
457.description: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

458.name: Mantyke
458.description: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

459.name: Snover
459.description: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

460.name: Abomasnow
460.description: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

461.name: Weavile
461.description: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

462.name: Magnezone
462.description: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

463.name: Lickilicky
463.description: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

464.name: Rhyperior
464.description: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.

465.name: Tangrowth
465.description: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

466.name: Electivire
466.description: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

467.name: Magmortar
467.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

468.name: Togekiss
468.description: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

469.name: Yanmega
469.description: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

470.name: Leafeon
470.description: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

471.name: Glaceon
471.description: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

472.name: Gliscor
472.description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

473.name: Mamoswine
473.description: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

474.name: Porygon-z
474.description: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

475.name: Gallade
475.description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

476.name: Probopass
476.description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

477.name: Dusknoir
477.description: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

478.name: Froslass
478.description: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

479.name: Rotom
479.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

heat.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

wash.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

frost.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

fan.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

mow.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

480.name: Uxie
480.description: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

481.name: Mesprit
481.description: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

482.name: Azelf
482.description: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

483.name: Dialga
483.description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

origin.description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

484.name: Palkia
484.description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

origin.description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

485.name: Heatran
485.description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

486.name: Regigigas
