486.description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

487.name: Giratina
487.description: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

origin.description: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

488.name: Cresselia
488.description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

489.name: Phione
489.description: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

490.name: Manaphy
490.description: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

491.name: Darkrai
491.description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

492.name: Shaymin
492.description: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

sky.description: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

493.name: Arceus
493.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

fire.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

water.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

electric.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

grass.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

ice.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

fighting.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

poison.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

ground.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

flying.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

psychic.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

bug.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

rock.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

ghost.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

dragon.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

dark.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

steel.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

fairy.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

normal.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

494.name: Victini
494.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

495.name: Snivy
495.description: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

496.name: Servine
496.description: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
496.evo_desc: Evolves from **Snivy** starting from Level **17** and Evolves to **Serperior** starting from Level **36**.

497.name: Serperior
497.description: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

498.name: Tepig
498.description: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

499.name: Pignite
499.description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
499.evo_desc: Evolves from **Tepig** starting from Level **17** and Evolves to **Emboar** starting from Level **36**.

500.name: Emboar
500.description: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

501.name: Oshawott
501.description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

502.name: Dewott
502.description: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
502.evo_desc: Evolves from **Oshawott** starting from Level **17** and Evolves to **Samurott** starting from Level **36**.

503.name: Samurott
503.description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

hisui.label: Hisui Form
hisui.description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

504.name: Patrat
504.description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

505.name: Watchog
505.description: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

506.name: Lillipup
506.description: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

507.name: Herdier
507.description: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
507.evo_desc: Evolves from **Lillipup** starting from Level **16** and Evolves to **Stoutland** starting from Level **32**.

508.name: Stoutland
508.description: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

509.name: Purrloin
509.description: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

510.name: Liepard
510.description: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

511.name: Pansage
511.description: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

512.name: Simisage
512.description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

513.name: Pansear
513.description: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

514.name: Simisear
514.description: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

515.name: Panpour
515.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

516.name: Simipour
516.description: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

517.name: Munna
517.description: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

518.name: Musharna
518.description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

519.name: Pidove
519.description: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

520.name: Tranquill
520.description: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
520.evo_desc: Evolves from **Pidove** starting from Level **21** and Evolves to **Unfezant** starting from Level **32**.

521.name: Unfezant
521.description: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.

522.name: Blitzle
522.description: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

523.name: Zebstrika
523.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

524.name: Roggenrola
524.description: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

525.name: Boldore
525.description: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
525.evo_desc: Evolves from **Roggenrola** starting from Level **25** and Evolves to **Gigalith** via **Trade**.

526.name: Gigalith
526.description: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

527.name: Woobat
527.description: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

528.name: Swoobat
528.description: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

529.name: Drilbur
529.description: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

530.name: Excadrill
530.description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

531.name: Audino
531.description: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

532.name: Timburr
532.description: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

533.name: Gurdurr
533.description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
533.evo_desc: Evolves from **Timburr** starting from Level **25** and Evolves to **Conkeldurr** via **Trade**.

534.name: Conkeldurr
534.description: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

535.name: Tympole
535.description: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

536.name: Palpitoad
536.description: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
536.evo_desc: Evolves from **Tympole** starting from Level **25** and Evolves to **Seismitoad** starting from Level **36**.

537.name: Seismitoad
537.description: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

538.name: Throh
538.description: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

539.name: Sawk
539.description: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

540.name: Sewaddle
540.description: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

541.name: Swadloon
541.description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
541.evo_desc: Evolves from **Sewaddle** starting from Level **20** and Evolves to **Leavanny** with **High Friendship**.

542.name: Leavanny
542.description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

543.name: Venipede
543.description: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

544.name: Whirlipede
544.description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
544.evo_desc: Evolves from **Venipede** starting from Level **22** and Evolves to **Scolipede** starting from Level **30**.

545.name: Scolipede
545.description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

546.name: Cottonee
546.description: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

547.name: Whimsicott
547.description: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

548.name: Petilil
548.description: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

549.name: Lilligant
549.description: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

hisui.label: Hisui Form
hisui.description: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

550.name: Basculin
550.description: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

551.name: Sandile
551.description: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

552.name: Krokorok
552.description: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
552.evo_desc: Evolves from **Sandile** starting from Level **29** and Evolves to **Krookodile** starting from Level **40**.

553.name: Krookodile
553.description: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

554.name: Darumaka
554.description: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

galar.label: Galar Form
galar.description: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

555.name: Darmanitan
555.description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

galar_standard.label: Galar Standard Form
galar_standard.description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

galar_zen.label: Galar Zen Form
galar_zen.description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

zen.label: Zen Form
zen.description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

556.name: Maractus
556.description: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

557.name: Dwebble
557.description: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

558.name: Crustle
558.description: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

559.name: Scraggy
559.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

560.name: Scrafty
560.description: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

561.name: Sigilyph
561.description: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

562.name: Yamask
562.description: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

galar.label: Galar Form
galar.description: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

563.name: Cofagrigus
563.description: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

564.name: Tirtouga
564.description: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

565.name: Carracosta
565.description: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

566.name: Archen
566.description: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

567.name: Archeops
567.description: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

568.name: Trubbish
568.description: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

569.name: Garbodor
569.description: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

570.name: Zorua
570.description: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

hisui.label: Hisui Form
hisui.description: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

571.name: Zoroark
571.description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

hisui.label: Hisui Form
hisui.description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

572.name: Minccino
572.description: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

573.name: Cinccino
573.description: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

574.name: Gothita
574.description: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

575.name: Gothorita
575.description: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
575.evo_desc: Evolves from **Gothita** starting from Level **32** and Evolves to **Gothitelle** starting from Level **41**.

576.name: Gothitelle
576.description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

577.name: Solosis
577.description: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

578.name: Duosion
578.description: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
578.evo_desc: Evolves from **Solosis** starting from Level **32** and Evolves to **Reuniclus** starting from Level **41**.

579.name: Reuniclus
579.description: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

580.name: Ducklett
580.description: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

581.name: Swanna
581.description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

582.name: Vanillite
582.description: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

583.name: Vanillish
583.description: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
583.evo_desc: Evolves from **Vanillite** starting from Level **35** and Evolves to **Vanilluxe** starting from Level **47**.

584.name: Vanilluxe
584.description: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

585.name: Deerling
585.description: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

586.name: Sawsbuck
586.description: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.

587.name: Emolga
587.description: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

588.name: Karrablast
588.description: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

589.name: Escavalier
589.description: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

590.name: Foongus
590.description: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

591.name: Amoonguss
591.description: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

592.name: Frillish
592.description: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

593.name: Jellicent
593.description: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

594.name: Alomomola
594.description: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

595.name: Joltik
595.description: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

596.name: Galvantula
596.description: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

597.name: Ferroseed
597.description: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

598.name: Ferrothorn
598.description: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

599.name: Klink
599.description: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

600.name: Klang
600.description: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
600.evo_desc: Evolves from **Klink** starting from Level **38** and Evolves to **Klinklang** starting from Level **49**.

601.name: Klinklang
601.description: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

602.name: Tynamo
602.description: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

603.name: Eelektrik
603.description: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
603.evo_desc: Evolves from **Tynamo** starting from Level **39** and Evolves to **Eelektross** using a **Thunder Stone**.

604.name: Eelektross
604.description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

605.name: Elgyem
605.description: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.

606.name: Beheeyem
606.description: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

607.name: Litwick
607.description: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

608.name: Lampent
608.description: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
608.evo_desc: Evolves from **Litwick** starting from Level **41** and Evolves to **Chandelure** using a **Dusk Stone**.

609.name: Chandelure
609.description: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

610.name: Axew
610.description: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

611.name: Fraxure
611.description: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
611.evo_desc: Evolves from **Axew** starting from Level **38** and Evolves to **Haxorus** starting from Level **48**.

612.name: Haxorus
612.description: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

613.name: Cubchoo
613.description: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

614.name: Beartic
614.description: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

615.name: Cryogonal
615.description: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

616.name: Shelmet
616.description: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

617.name: Accelgor
617.description: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

618.name: Stunfisk
618.description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

galar.label: Galar Form
galar.description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

619.name: Mienfoo
619.description: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

620.name: Mienshao
620.description: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

621.name: Druddigon
621.description: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

622.name: Golett
622.description: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

623.name: Golurk
623.description: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

624.name: Pawniard
624.description: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

625.name: Bisharp
625.description: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
625.evo_desc: Evolves from **Pawniard** starting from Level **52** and Evolves to **Kingambit** via **Special Condition**.

626.name: Bouffalant
626.description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

627.name: Rufflet
627.description: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

628.name: Braviary
628.description: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

hisui.label: Hisui Form
hisui.description: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

629.name: Vullaby
629.description: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

630.name: Mandibuzz
630.description: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

631.name: Heatmor
631.description: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

632.name: Durant
632.description: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

633.name: Deino
633.description: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

634.name: Zweilous
634.description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
634.evo_desc: Evolves from **Deino** starting from Level **50** and Evolves to **Hydreigon** starting from Level **64**.

635.name: Hydreigon
635.description: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

636.name: Larvesta
636.description: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

637.name: Volcarona
637.description: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.

638.name: Cobalion
638.description: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

639.name: Terrakion
639.description: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

640.name: Virizion
640.description: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

641.name: Tornadus
641.description: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

therian.label: Therian Form
therian.description: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

642.name: Thundurus
642.description: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

therian.label: Therian Form
therian.description: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

643.name: Reshiram
643.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

644.name: Zekrom
644.description: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

645.name: Landorus
645.description: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

therian.label: Therian Form
therian.description: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

646.name: Kyurem
646.description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

black.label: Black Form
black.description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

white.label: White Form
white.description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

647.name: Keldeo
647.description: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

648.name: Meloetta
648.description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

pirouette.label: Pirouette Form
pirouette.description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

649.name: Genesect
649.description: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.

650.name: Chespin
650.description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

651.name: Quilladin
651.description: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
651.evo_desc: Evolves from **Chespin** starting from Level **16** and Evolves to **Chesnaught** starting from Level **36**.

652.name: Chesnaught
652.description: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

653.name: Fennekin
653.description: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

654.name: Braixen
654.description: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
654.evo_desc: Evolves from **Fennekin** starting from Level **16** and Evolves to **Delphox** starting from Level **36**.

655.name: Delphox
655.description: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

656.name: Froakie
656.description: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

657.name: Frogadier
657.description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
657.evo_desc: Evolves from **Froakie** starting from Level **16** and Evolves to **Greninja** starting from Level **36**.

658.name: Greninja
658.description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

ash.label: Ash Form
ash.description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

659.name: Bunnelby
659.description: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

660.name: Diggersby
660.description: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

661.name: Fletchling
661.description: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

662.name: Fletchinder
662.description: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
662.evo_desc: Evolves from **Fletchling** starting from Level **17** and Evolves to **Talonflame** starting from Level **35**.

663.name: Talonflame
663.description: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

664.name: Scatterbug
664.description: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

665.name: Spewpa
665.description: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
665.evo_desc: Evolves from **Scatterbug** starting from Level **9** and Evolves to **Vivillon** starting from Level **12**.

666.name: Vivillon
666.description: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

667.name: Litleo
667.description: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

668.name: Pyroar
668.description: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

669.name: Flabebe
669.description: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

670.name: Floette
670.description: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
670.evo_desc: Evolves from **Flabebe** starting from Level **19** and Evolves to **Florges** using a **Shiny Stone**.

eternal.label: Eternal Form
eternal.description: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

671.name: Florges
671.description: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

672.name: Skiddo
672.description: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

673.name: Gogoat
673.description: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

674.name: Pancham
674.description: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

675.name: Pangoro
675.description: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

676.name: Furfrou
676.description: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

677.name: Espurr
677.description: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

678.name: Meowstic
678.description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

679.name: Honedge
679.description: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

680.name: Doublade
680.description: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
680.evo_desc: Evolves from **Honedge** starting from Level **35** and Evolves to **Aegislash** using a **Dusk Stone**.

681.name: Aegislash
681.description: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

blade.label: Blade Form
blade.description: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

682.name: Spritzee
682.description: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

683.name: Aromatisse
683.description: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

684.name: Swirlix
684.description: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

685.name: Slurpuff
685.description: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

686.name: Inkay
686.description: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

687.name: Malamar
687.description: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

688.name: Binacle
688.description: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

689.name: Barbaracle
689.description: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

690.name: Skrelp
690.description: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

691.name: Dragalge
691.description: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

692.name: Clauncher
692.description: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

693.name: Clawitzer
693.description: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

694.name: Helioptile
694.description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

695.name: Heliolisk
695.description: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

696.name: Tyrunt
696.description: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

697.name: Tyrantrum
697.description: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

698.name: Amaura
698.description: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

699.name: Aurorus
699.description: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

700.name: Sylveon
700.description: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

701.name: Hawlucha
701.description: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

702.name: Dedenne
702.description: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

703.name: Carbink
703.description: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

704.name: Goomy
704.description: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.

705.name: Sliggoo
705.description: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.
705.evo_desc: Evolves from **Goomy** starting from Level **40** and Evolves to **Goodra** starting from Level **50**.

hisui.label: Hisui Form
hisui.description: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.

706.name: Goodra
706.description: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

707.name: Klefki
707.description: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

708.name: Phantump
708.description: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

709.name: Trevenant
709.description: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

710.name: Pumpkaboo
710.description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

711.description: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

712.name: Bergmite
712.description: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

713.name: Avalugg
713.description: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

714.name: Noibat
714.description: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

715.name: Noivern
715.description: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

716.name: Xerneas
716.description: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

717.name: Yveltal
717.description: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

718.name: Zygarde
718.description: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

719.name: Diancie
719.description: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

720.name: Hoopa
720.description: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

unbound.description: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

721.name: Volcanion
721.description: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
